body: REDGARDEN commit 53d9c20. Both already had full lore entries in TYLER/multiverse_heroes.md (#35 Gary, #42 Flute Debt). Gary: stationary marksman, no dash of any kind, Q is a range-gated precision shot, W toggles Q's own range, R is a fixed-duration root. Flute Debt: real debt/payoff mechanic via the shared burning_ms DoT -- Q applies it, R collects bonus damage only if it's still active. ARENA_HERO_COUNT 12->14, wired into every real call site. Verified via build.sh, build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, test_10_bots.sh, and a local mingw cross-compile, all clean. Closes BACKLOG S170-91.
title: 13th/14th heroes: Gary and Flute Debt, real kits from existing lore
